title: Answer: no account of what is emergent, only that it must rest on the present state

statements.text: The theorem takes no position on what is emergent. It constrains whatever a theory says consciousness arises from: that basis must be a feature of the present physical state, and history, process or computation can matter only through the state they leave. Which present feature it is, the paper leaves to other theories.
statements.scope: the no-go theorem, version 1 of the preprint

sources.quote: The remaining response is the corollary: history matters only through the present physical state it produces.
